summary: Jackson County, Wisconsin fire tower with a 1931 record and a 1930s build; decommissioned in 2016 and still standing, with its stairway blocked from public use.

facts.status_note: Decommissioned as a fire lookout in 2016; the tower still stands but its stairway is blocked from public use.

access.note: Tower stairway blocked from public use; the land is Jackson County Forest and the public has ready access to the summit, per SummitPost.

visit.trail_note: No parking lot; visitors pull off the road and follow the old sandy two-track to the summit. The tower stairway is blocked from public use, so do not climb the tower.

events.note: NHLR says a tower has been at the site since at least 1931; an August 25, 1931 Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune item quoted by Forest Lookouts refers to the Saddle Mound fire tower
Decommissioned as a fire lookout along with the other remaining Wisconsin towers; stairway now blocked from public use
Registered March 14, 2019 as US 1293, WI 53; nominated by Brecken Young

resolved_conflicts.explanation: SummitPost says the public has ready access to the peak on Jackson County Forest land, but also says the tower stairway is blocked from public use. The story treats the summit as reachable on foot and the tower as closed to climbing, and says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: The build year is not pinned: NHLR says a tower has been at the site since at least 1931, and SummitPost says the fire tower was built in the 1930s, so no built event is recorded. The 2016 decommissioning and blocked stairway rest on one hiking guide (SummitPost); a second check on the state's 2015-2016 tower decisions was attempted (apg-wi.com) but returned HTTP 429 during the run. SummitPost contradicts itself on public access to the summit, which is noted in resolved_conflicts. The social-media and video search results were not used. The brief's access 'unknown' is now restricted; the brief's record is otherwise consistent with NHLR and the FFLOS county list. The NHLR page carries a 'courtesy of Doug Urban' photo credit with no image URL, so no photo was recorded.
